_note: Synthetic. The state fails at one point of a tick: every write of a cursor aborts, or the read of the budget's cache fails (its last attempt past the probes' interval, the claim of a new probe aborted, so no provider is asked). A tick that reaches the point fails and writes nothing; one that does not reach it is not touched; a failure in the middle of a series neither counts nor resets it, and the stall comes when it would have.
transcribes: test_precheck.py::TestFailClosed::test_runtime_guasto_in_ogni_punto (scrivi_cursore and sonda_cache; the other points stay with the prototype's tests)
test_precheck.py::TestStallo::test_un_errore_non_conta_e_non_azzera (the error at scrivi_cursore and at sonda_cache, where the prototype's test makes elenca fail)

runs.note: a ready task, the cursor's write fails: error
a ready task, the cache's read fails: error
nothing to start: the cache is not read
nothing to count and no series: no cursor is written
a held lock: a failed write in the middle of the series

ticks.note: three ticks and an hour and a half: a stall

runs.note: the same ready task: a failed read of the cache in the middle of the series

ticks.note: the third tick of the series: a stall
